<!-- Generated by genconfdocs from the config structs in server/config. Do not edit. -->

gochannel is in-process; NATS is required for multi-instance and split-process deployments.  gochannel (in-process) is the default and suitable for single-instance deployments. NATS is required for multi-instance deployments where multiple ssoosshd processes share a database.

## `pubsub.backend`

`string`, default `gochannel`

Selects which message-broker implementation to use. "gochannel" (default) is in-process, suitable for single-instance. "nats" is required for multi-instance deployments.

## `pubsub.nats`

Holds NATS-specific configuration. Required when Backend is "nats".

## `pubsub.nats.url`

`string`, default `empty`

The NATS server connection string, e.g. "nats://nats.example.com:4222". Empty disables NATS (leaves Backend at gochannel).

## `pubsub.nats.cert_file`

`string`, default `empty`

The path to the client certificate for mTLS authentication. Required when URL is set.

## `pubsub.nats.key_file`

`string`, default `empty`

The path to the client certificate's private key. Required when URL is set.

## `pubsub.nats.ca_file`

`string`, default `empty`

The path to the CA certificate to verify the NATS server. Required when URL is set.
